Profile.title: PROFILE
Profile.description:
I started learning programming in junior high school, and now I conduct research in AI, security, and networking.
I call anomaly detection and data analysis my specialties.
Beyond AI, I am also taking on web development and cloud infrastructure.

historyItems.1: Currently enrolled in the Department of Information Systems Design (admitted April 2023)
historyItems.2: Developed several AI-related projects on my own
historyItems.4: Co-authored a paper accepted at an international conference

1.title: Proposal of a Missing-Data Imputation Technique for HAR (Human Activity Recognition)
1.issue: Prediction accuracy of existing models degrades when data is missing
1.method: An imputation method combining an autoencoder and a CGAN
1.experiment: Achieved comparable prediction accuracy even with missing data
1.contribution: This enables real-time imputation of missing data
1.overview: Proposal of a Missing-Data Imputation Technique for HAR (Human Activity Recognition)

2.title: Proposal of NNRGL, a Dependent Causal Discovery Method
2.issue: Existing causal discovery methods struggle with high-dimensional analysis and tend to have low accuracy
2.method: A causal discovery method combining a neural network and group lasso
2.experiment: Achieved highly accurate results more easily than existing causal discovery methods
2.contribution: Enables more efficient causal discovery on high-dimensional data
2.overview: Proposal of NNRGL, a Dependent Causal Discovery Method

3.title: Proposal of a Method that Treats Attacks in Network Flows as Imbalanced Data
3.issue: Cyber attacks rarely occur, so training an AI on them yields imbalanced data and degrades performance
3.method: Aims to improve accuracy by treating cyber attacks as imbalanced data
3.overview: No detailed content is available yet.

Portfolio-Website.title: Malin's Portfolio

Tic-Tac-Toe-AI.title: Tic Tac Toe AI
Tic-Tac-Toe-AI.description: I implemented in Python an AI agent that learns tic-tac-toe through reinforcement learning. It acquires an optimal strategy through self-play using Q-learning. This is the first reinforcement learning model I built.

recognize-handwritten-digits.title: Handwritten Letter Recognition
recognize-handwritten-digits.description: I built a model that recognizes handwritten English letters. It achieves high-accuracy recognition using a neural network. Training and evaluation were done with the EMNIST dataset.

exp-001.title: Backend Engineer
exp-001.description:

Also experienced in building and operating development environments with Docker and using various AWS services.

exp-002.title: ML Engineer / Research Assistant
exp-002.description:

Responsible for the PyTorch implementation and evaluation of a neural-network-based causal discovery method.
Engaged in data preprocessing, model implementation, and paper writing using Python.

exp-003.title: Short-term Web Development Internship
exp-003.description:

Future.title: FUTURE
Future.vision: Delivering trustworthy AI behind the scenes of society

1.title: Explainability
1.description: High accuracy alone does not make an AI that people can use with confidence. Why did it reach that decision, and how far can it be trusted? I value being able to explain the behavior of AI.

2.title: Robust Architecture
2.description: The less visible a system is, the less it can afford to stop. Rather than temporary accuracy or trends, I value designs built to keep running for the long term.

3.title: Full Stack Perspective
3.description: Building a model is not the goal. Where is that AI used, who does it reach, and how is it operated? Taking backend and infrastructure into view as well, I aim for AI that works in society.
